children: Scandinavian Astor Group AB (publ) (”Astor Group” or the ”Company”) has, through a company within the Astor Protect business area, received an order worth approximately SEK 35 million from an international customer in the western world. The order involves the delivery of defense supplies and is scheduled to be fulfilled during the second half of 2026.
“This order is clear proof of our competitiveness and our ability to deliver in a sector where demand is high. It is also the result of the long-term efforts being made at Astor Protect,”
says Martin Elovsson, CEO of Astor Group.
Due to the nature of the industry and circumstances relating to customers and national security interests, no further information regarding this matter or the customer will be disclosed.
Please note that this is an English translation of a press release written in Swedish by Scandinavian Astor Group AB (publ), in the event of any inaccuracies, the Swedish version applies.
Scandinavian Astor Group – Impact through unity
Scandinavian Astor Group CEO Martin Elovsson

This information is information that Scandinavian Astor Group is obliged to make public pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-17 11:17:04 CEST.

Scandinavian Astor Group is a Swedish defense group shaping the future of security and protection. Through its two business areas - Astor Industry and Astor Protect - the Group delivers advanced technology, high-quality components and critical security solutions to primarily the defense, industry and public safety sectors. Astor Group is listed on NGM Main Market (ticker: ASTOR) and Boerse Stuttgart. The Company is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. For more information about Astor Group's business, visit: www.astorgroup.se
